description: FY63 F-4C-15-MC block 63-7407/7420 c/n 328; first flight 14 Aug 1963; 4453rd CCTW and 58th TFTW; Missouri and Texas ANG; Arkansas ANG 184th TFS Fort Smith Oct 1985-88 and flown at Gunsmoke 85; marked as TAC's Oldest F-4 in 1988; withdrawn 9 Jun 1988; NMUSAF loan to 188 MXS; repainted Jun 2015 (DVIDS); towed with the other five displays from the 188th Wing entrance to the Signature Aviation ramp on 11 Jul 2025 for about three years while the FMS training centre and a new entry control point are built (Talk Business and Politics Aug 2025); viewable through the FBO fence
museum_name: 188th Wing Static Display Collection -- Fort Smith Regional Airport

description: FY53 F-100A-20-NA block 53-1609/1708 c/n 192-124; roll-out 18 Jun 1955; 479th TFW George AFB as FW-629; Arizona ANG 152nd TFTS; GF-100A ground trainer at Amarillo and Sheppard; Lackland security-police training area 1977; to the 188th c.2000; Baugher saw it in 2013 painted 54-629; NMUSAF loan; moved to the Signature ramp 11 Jul 2025
museum_name: 188th Wing Static Display Collection -- Fort Smith Regional Airport

description: Built as an F-101C-45-MC c/n 157 (FY56 block 56-006/019) and taken on strength 26 Dec 1957; 27th TFW Bergstrom and 81st TFW Bentwaters; converted RF-101H; Arkansas ANG 154th TRS then Kentucky and Nevada ANG; MASDC FF277 1972; displayed at the Pima Air and Space Museum 1975-2007; NMUSAF loan to 188 MXS; moved to the Signature ramp 11 Jul 2025
museum_name: 188th Wing Static Display Collection -- Fort Smith Regional Airport

description: FY77 A-10A block 77-0177/0276 c/n A10-0141; first flight 5 Sep 1978; 354th TFW Myrtle Beach; converted OA-10A with the 355th TFW; ground-instruction airframe at Pope AFB 1995-2006; displayed at the 188th by Apr 2008 (the wing flew A-10Cs 2007-14 and the 2025 press calls the display an A-10C but the serial is an A-model); NMUSAF loan; moved to the Signature ramp 11 Jul 2025
museum_name: 188th Wing Static Display Collection -- Fort Smith Regional Airport

description: FY82 F-16A Block 15M range 82-0966/0986 c/n 61-563; taken on strength 14 Dec 1983; 612th TFS 401st TFW Torrejon; Arkansas ANG 184th TFS/FS Fort Smith from Jun 1988; displayed Mar 2004; NMUSAF loan to 188 MXS; the Aug 2025 press article calls it an F-16C but the serial is a Block 15 A-model; moved to the Signature ramp 11 Jul 2025
museum_name: 188th Wing Static Display Collection -- Fort Smith Regional Airport

description: FY51 RF-84F-15-RE block 51-11258/11294 c/n 173; 71st SRW Larson; 432nd TRG; Mississippi and Michigan ANG; Arkansas ANG 184th TRS from 1966; NMUSAF loan to 188 MXS; Baugher noted it preserved at Fort Smith 11 Oct 2004; stood north of the other five at 35.343064 -94.368922 before the move; moved to the Signature ramp 11 Jul 2025
museum_name: 188th Wing Static Display Collection -- Fort Smith Regional Airport
